[No sleep nor slumber to his eyes
Till he had found below the skies
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 132:4–5, 7–8, 15–17, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

4I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids, 5until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.” 7Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool. 8Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength. 15I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread. 16I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy. 17There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
